messages:
Olivia (CSM): Quick heads-up — Northlane renewal in 6 weeks. Usage down ~48% over the last 30d and we just heard their new CFO is doing a cost consolidation review and asked for alternatives. Need an immediate renewal triage.
Ian (Account Exec): Ugh. Do we know if it's seat churn or lower token/embedding calls? Any recent support tickets?
Olivia (CSM): Mostly fewer API calls; embeddings calls down particularly. No major support tickets — a couple of prompt-related questions from their ML team but nothing escalated.
Priya (RevOps): Pulled their dashboard: last month avg tokens/day 1.2M -> this month 620k. Active seats stable (28). Top usage dropped in two services: "semantic-search" and "similarity-batch".
Sam (Solutions Eng): Flags: new CFO + cost review = likely price/efficiency ask. Quick technical wins: suggest recommending batching & prefix cache config, and light-quantization model variant for embeddings. Can draft config suggestions.
Olivia (CSM): Good. Ian — can you share any notes from last exec sync about objectives? Need to know if they're prioritizing accuracy over cost.
Ian (Account Exec): From last month: product and data science push for search accuracy; finance now pushing cost. Mixed signals. I can get a 1:1 with their CFO but would prefer a tangible "cost mitigation" plan to present.
Priya (RevOps): Here's a short data snippet from the usage export:
```
period, tokens, embeddings_calls
2026-02-01, 1_100_000, 45_000
2026-03-01, 620_000, 18_900
```
Olivia (CSM): @Sam — can you prepare a 15-min tech brief + 3 config playbook options (conservative, balanced, aggressive) we can show the CFO? Need before EOD Friday.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Will do. Draft plan:
- Conservative: enable KV prefix cache + small batching -> ~15% cost reduction, minimal accuracy impact
- Balanced: above + switch embedding model to 8-bit quant variant -> ~35% cost reduction, slight accuracy delta
- Aggressive: move bulk similarity workloads to offline jobs + heavy quant -> ~55% reduction but longer latency
Priya (RevOps): Also recommend a 30-day "pilot pricing buffer" for renewal conversation: small discount + SLA-backed throughput guarantee. Ian, want me to model expected $ impact for CFO deck?
Ian (Account Exec): Yes please. Include projected unit costs and expected net revenue impact.
triage-bot: [alert] account_health: usage_drop_48pct; projected_renewal_risk=high; last_activity=2026-03-12; triggered_by=embedding_calls_decrease
Olivia (CSM): Nice — can we also capture qualitative feedback? I have a note from their ML lead: "search quality has marginally regressed with new prompt set; exploring open-source alternatives for embeddings." I'll add that to the deck.
Sam (Solutions Eng): For the deck I’ll include simulation results: precision@10 delta across quant variants + latency table. Small code snippet to repro embeddings eval:
```
python eval_embeddings.py --dataset northlane_queries.csv --model r-instruct-embed-8bit
```
Olivia (CSM): Plan for next steps:
1) Sam — deliver playbook + quick eval artifacts by Thu noon
2) Priya — cost model & renewal buffer scenarios by Thu EOD
3) Ian — schedule 30-min CFO chat for Mon morning (aim for tying to renewal timeline)
4) Olivia — prepare account health one-pager and stakeholder map
Ian (Account Exec): I'm booking the slot. Also suggest offering a short enablement session for their ML team (30m) to show quant tradeoffs.
Olivia (CSM): Agreed. Sam, can you host the enablement? If yes, set 2 available times and I'll propose.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Yes — propose Wed 10am or Thu 3pm PT. Will include a short walkthrough + Q&A.
Priya (RevOps): I'll run sensitivity on ARR impact and show 3-month runway scenarios if they accept vs decline the pilot.
Olivia (CSM): Thanks team. Logging this as the official renewal triage thread.
Ian (Account Exec): @Olivia please tag me when the playbook is ready; I'll loop the CFO.
triage-bot: [note] ticket 47291 created: "Northlane renewal triage" assigned_to=Olivia (CSM)
Olivia (CSM): Added — will update thread with assets. :thumbsup:
